proposed_decision.rationale: Current @hnk/glyphs authority distinguishes the two segments; FROZEN Y-bearing forms and DAYI depend on G40 identity; stale /j/ treatment in older HOYU metadata should be repaired downstream rather than used to rewrite G40 silently.

governance_decisions.proposal: B1 approval does not define syllable boundaries, diphthongs, hiatus, glide formation, lexical stress or allophony.
B1 approval does not change safe romanization coverage; G16 romanization remains unresolved for B5.
B1 approval does not approve a canonical whole-word pronunciation for DAYI, HOYU, SARADAYA, TAYOVAN or VAMATAYA.
B1 approval does not change DAYI semantics, HOYU numeral semantics, morphology, grammar, productivity or curriculum slots.
If G40 identity is not affirmed, stop dependent Sprint B phonology gates and prepare a separate G40 reassignment evidence/design gate; do not mutate @hnk/glyphs from this gate.

approval_rule: A future SIGA may approve only DEC-B1-001 through DEC-B1-006 if this gate remains materially unchanged. The same SIGA must not approve B2.
